svg.title: Reconciling a payment against its request
svg.desc: An illustrative reconciliation card, with synthetic values, for request INV-0001, 0.01 CBTC. Five axes, each answered on its own: amount (exact, partial, overpaid, unknown), timing (on-time, late, unknown), instrument (match, mismatch, unknown), receiver (match, mismatch, unknown) and policy (satisfied, violated, unknown). Then a readiness: eligible for closure, requires review, or not satisfied. Flags describe the evidence, not the payment. The library reports readiness; closing is the caller's decision.
